components.name: Button
rules: Single accessible action; loading keeps width and prevents double submit.
Focus ring is additive, not a replacement for label.

components.name: IconButton
rules: 48 logical px target; tooltip optional; selected state text available to AT.

components.name: SearchField
rules: Clear has accessible name; real label not only placeholder; error linked to input.

components.name: SegmentedControl
rules: Single selection; labels retained; keyboard arrows and selected semantics.

components.name: Navigation
rules: Exactly four primary destinations; same labels across layouts; safe area outside content height.

components.name: SongCard
rules: Arrangement distinguished from composition; no fake popularity, ratings or mastered percentage.

components.name: ProgressBadge
rules: Basis visible; steps completion is not skill mastery.

components.name: SkillChip
rules: Status has text, not only color; check requires evidence basis.

components.name: LessonStepCard
rules: Can choose music despite recommendations; skipped is not passed.

components.name: ScoreViewport
rules: Real engraving, not unicode imitation; stable musical coordinates on resize; interactive accessible note list alternate.

components.name: PianoKeyboard
rules: Correct 2/3 black-key groups; show octave anchors; expected and played remain distinct.

components.name: PianoKey
rules: No overlapping hit regions; narrow targets have NotePad alternative; status not color alone.

components.name: ChordCard
rules: Displays exact voicing/inversion; unknown chord label is not invented.

components.name: FingeringHint
rules: Separate hand diagrams; no claim of MIDI verification.

components.name: PracticeTransport
rules: Composes C02,C16,C17,C18,C19; no controls over playable score; one audio owner.

components.name: TempoControl
rules: Slider plus exact value and plus/minus controls; edit pauses playback; no silent source-score modification.

components.name: LoopControl
rules: Non-drag selection path; inclusive UI/exclusive engine end; invalid range explained.

components.name: HandSelector
rules: Target and audio are separate settings; staff/track not blindly equated to hand.

components.name: MetronomeControl
rules: Visual beat can be shown with audio off; no unrelated device permission.

components.name: FeedbackPanel
rules: No precision score when basis cannot support it; one useful correction.

components.name: BottomSheet
rules: Focus management and labelled close; playback pauses; content scrolls; safe-area respected.

components.name: Dialog
rules: Explicit destructive scope; keyboard focus trap and return; no accidental data loss.

components.name: TheoryInspector
rules: Context retained; short explanation plus optional detail; external media never required for core lesson.

components.name: StatePanel
rules: Tells why and how to continue; no perpetual loading without cancel/retry.

components.name: CapabilityBadge
rules: Connected is real device state; do not hardcode browser-name assumptions.

components.name: InputSelector
rules: Permission only on explicit connect; self-report always usable.

components.name: OfflineCard
rules: Ready only after every required resource and record is committed; retry does not delete progress.

components.name: BackupPanel
rules: Restore preview before destructive replacement; corrupt/newer backup rejected; not cloud sync.

components.name: AppShell
rules: Composition not separate apps; font scaling and safe area; no forced account gate.

components.name: NotePad
rules: Large non-overlapping48px targets; full pitch label+octave; supports screen-reader exercises.
